description:
Scaffold the command-center scenario from scratch with a React+Vite UI and Go API backend at scenarios/command-center/.

**UI shell requirements:**
- React+Vite using the react-vite template (per project convention: every scenario must have a UI)
- Router with one route per dashboard page (6 pages planned: Mission Control, The Hive, The Forge, Ledger, Broadcast, Panorama)
- Navigation system that's hidden by default (kiosk-first), appears on mouse movement or touch, auto-hides after inactivity timeout
- Settings panel (also hidden by default) for: selecting active dashboard, configuring auto-cycle timing, entering/exiting fullscreen, adjusting per-dashboard settings
- Page transition animations between dashboards during auto-cycle
- Responsive layout that looks good on large TVs (primary target) down to tablet screens

**API requirements:**
- Go API service with standard scenario lifecycle (service.json, Makefile, health checks)
- Endpoint structure: /api/v1/dashboards/{dashboard-id} per dashboard page returning pre-composed data payloads
- /api/v1/gaps endpoint returning all metrics with dataSource status of "gap" or "partial", grouped by dashboard
- /api/v1/health standard health endpoint
- Caching layer with configurable TTLs for upstream data source queries
- No database of its own — purely a read-only aggregation service

**Scenario configuration:**
- service.json with proper ports, health checks, dependencies on LPBS, swarm-manager, and vrooli core
- Makefile with standard targets (start, stop, test, logs)
- Category: "business-application", tags: ["react-ui", "go-api", "dashboard", "monitoring", "kiosk"]
name: command-center-scenario-scaffold
title: Create command-center scenario with React UI shell and Go API
